evidence.detail: The class stores exactly two immutable ints; the first is consumed as item ID for icon lookup and validity, while the second is rendered as the quantity and color-formatted through the client quantity formatter.
R345 LoadoutBinaryCodec reads/writes exactly two ints for every equipment-slot and inventory-slot record and reconstructs this class from those itemId/quantity pairs.
R143 LoadoutDefinition stores these entries in its equipment-slot map and 28-slot inventory array; the type has no unrelated state.
Its c() helper resolves the first/item-id field through LoadoutItemIconCache and returns a GuiImageAsset for rendering.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 itemId/quantity value record used by LoadoutDefinition equipment and inventory slots.

evidence.detail: The enum contains 29 named loadout categories/icons including MELEE, RANGE, MAGIC, PURE, WELFARE, SKULL, RED_SKULL, HOTSPOT, SLAYER and BLOOD_SLAYER, each paired with a user-visible label and /assets/gui/icons/*.png resource.
R345 LoadoutBinaryCodec explicitly serializes/deserializes the optional icon enum stored on R143 LoadoutDefinition; this is that exact enum type.
LoadoutsSidebarPanel and loadout editing/rendering surfaces use this enum to present/select the icon associated with a saved loadout definition.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 semantic name for the named icon enum stored by LoadoutDefinition.

evidence.detail: The class owns a static ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, GuiImageAsset> keyed by LoadoutItemEntry item ID and returns a cached asset when present.
On cache miss it dispatches the item ID through one of five loader helpers and returns null until the generated 32x32 item image is inserted into the cache.
The class is referenced throughout the Loadouts model/rendering family and by LoadoutsSidebarPanel, with no non-loadout consumer.
LoadoutItemEntry.c() constructs this cache wrapper from its item ID and returns the resolved GuiImageAsset.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the shared Loadouts item-image cache/resolver.
